title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Accounts Receivable: Application of Client Payments
content:
Client payments on a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement are applied as follows.

1. A payment is applied to the invoice its remittance names.
2. When the remittance names no invoice, it is applied to the oldest open invoice first, by posted date and then by invoice number, and any remainder to the next oldest, posting one payment entry per invoice applied.
3. Partial payments are accepted and leave the rest of the invoice open.
4. An amount beyond every open invoice stays on the agreement as a credit balance against future invoices.
5. Card payments are accepted only for an invoice whose total does not exceed the tier's card limit; larger invoices are paid by ACH, wire or check.
6. A remittance reference is applied to a given invoice only once. Whether it already has been is read from the billing ledger: a payment entry with that remittance reference on that invoice.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Open invoices: one posted 2025-05-01 with 300.00 open and one posted 2025-06-01 with 900.00 open. A remittance of 1000.00 naming no invoice pays 300.00 on the May invoice and 700.00 on the June invoice, which keeps 200.00 open; two payment entries are posted. Had the remittance been 1500.00, both would be paid and 300.00 would stay as a credit balance.

**Order of oldest first.** Two open invoices posted on the same date are taken in invoice-number order.
